data.comment:
# Comfy VEED Lipsync 2.0- Lip Sync

Re-sync a speaker's mouth in footage you already shot to a new speech track with VEED Lipsync 2.0. The person on camera speaks the new audio while the rest of the shot stays as recorded; the output keeps the video's resolution at 25 fps and runs as long as the audio, up to 600 seconds. If the clip is shorter than the speech it plays forward and backward until the audio ends. Ideal for dubbing a line, swapping a script without re-shooting, or making localized versions of existing footage. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_veed_lipsync_2_0.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
